title: Nourishing Croatian Sirloin Steak Tips Stew
description: A rich and comforting Croatian dish featuring sirloin steak tips, this stew is perfect for a cold winter night, made in a mason jar for a unique presentation.

ingredients.name: candy
ingredients.notes: diced dried fruit like apricots or cranberries

instructions: Heat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium high heat.
Add the sirloin steak tips and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the steak tips from the pan and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pan and cook for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the beef broth, tomato paste, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the broth mixture to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the browned steak tips back to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the stew to a large mason jar and add the diced candy on top.
Cover the mason jar with a lid and bake for 2 hours.
